title: From Bytes to Biases: Investigating the Cultural Self-Perception of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' (ChatGPT and Bard) cultural self-perception by prompting them with 39 value questions from the GLOBE project using a 7-point Likert scale, calculating their scores across nine societal cultural dimensions, and using Euclidean distance and cosine similarity to compare their alignments against the national cultures of 62 countries.

Comparing the models' cultural dimension scores and country alignments when prompted with the GLOBE survey in English versus French to observe how the input language alters the models' cultural self-perception.
